content.title: <TextStyle.Red>👋 Welcome to StoneAge Society Servers!</>
content.text:
Welcome to StoneAge Society Servers,  
 
 Please make a tribe. 
<TextStyle.LightBlue>Do not use names like 123 or human, Do not use profanity or derogatory names, you will be removed and youir base decayed.</>

 Daily restarts start at 5:00 am CST 

 This server is a WIP settings and mods are subject to change. 

 We use auto decay, if your tribe is offline for more than 8 days your dinos and structures will be auto-wiped. To check the decay time on any structure or dino, target them with your crosshair and type /decaytime for the time remaining. 
(VIP gets 16 days)
 
 Structures that have less than 20 items will decay in 2 days (usually for unmanned taming pens)
(VIP gets 4 Days for Rapid Decay)

By typing /decaytime in chat when looking at your structures, you will see the area in which a base will decay.
This will also tell you the time in which the base will decay.
 
 This is a US server. Please only speak English in General Chat.

content.title: <TextStyle.Blue>Rules</>
content.text:
By playing on this server you consent to the rules laid out below: 
 
 -Do not use Profanity in general chat. a filter is in place. 
 
 -Any items or exploits found that bypass the mod progression will be removed immediately and multiple infractions will result in a ban. 
 
 -Do not use names that are derogatory, offensive, or contain vulgarity.  Your character will be renamed. 
 
 -No excessive placement of structures, pillars, foundations, etc. (i.e. structure spamming) 
 
 -No Building or blocking of caves or concentrated resource locations that include artifacts or loot crates or have more than 6 nodes of resources. 
 
 -No blocking of obelisks. 
 
 -No hacking or abusing any game bugs or game exploits. 
 
 -No dropping or leading/kiting dinos into someone's base for the purpose of killing their dinos or destroying their base. This will lead to an immediate ban. 
 
 -No blocking resource spawns with random structures or small bases. 
 
 -No placing structures near an enemy base to cause harassment. 
 
 -No Placing any structure for future building or holding any spot even if its temporary. Random buildings found will have ALL tribe structures wiped. So if you have a new person in your tribe, make sure they did NOT build random buildings on the beach or any location.

content.title: <TextStyle.Blue>Rules Cont</>
content.text:
-Do not leave taming pens unattended, this would be the same as a second structure and ALL tribe structures will be wiped 
 
 -One 50x50 base per tribe per Map. Do not exceed 20 walls high. 
 
 -Do NOT leave your dinos out use soulballs. Dinos left out in the world will be destroyed. No more than 10 dinos should be out at a time (Except for gachas and other dinos that only produce outside of terminal, or while actively breeding. 
 
 -No racism or verbal bullying in-game,  zero tolerance is in effect for this rule.
 
 -Do not give away or trade tames/saddles to players that have not already tamed/crafted them.  Do not give away or trade items, resources, or Fertilized Eggs to players that are lower level or haven't progressed to that stage of the mod/game. 
 
 -Abusing any mechanic or broken ark mechanic may result in you being banned. 
 
 -All Teleporters in the wild MUST be set to public. Failure to do this will result in limiting only 1 per tribe. Max amount of teleporters per tribe is 5 
 
 -The Max amount of Beds in the wild is limited to 10 more than that will be instantly destroyed. Use sleeping bags.

-Do not hang around players doing bosses or Dinos that give aoe loot just to get free loot or get items that are higher than your progression.  This includes jumping into a fight when you were not asked to. 
 
 -Do not help new players to get egg by killing off wyverns in the wyvern trench or dinos that produce eggs on death. they must get them on their own. 
 
 -No Breeding of dinos with no gender, these would be mod dinos and are too OP for the mod and not balanced

content.title: <TextStyle.Blue>Rules Cont</>
content.text:
Boss & Event Rules

For Bosses that are summoned
No bossing in the open world. Bossing is restricted to our public arenas. (Access via Teleporter)
No drop-stealing from boss fights.
No kiting bosses to uninvolved players, or any other form of boss-related griefing. If you summon a boss you can’t handle, ask for help in general chat or ask if an admin is available to wipe it. 
Keep our arenas clean. No clutter! Do not leave boss structures in the arena after use. Pick them up and take them with you when you leave.

content.title: <TextStyle.Green>Information</>
content.text:
Do Not Build with Vanilla Structures (They May Not Lock)
Instead Build with either Cyberstructures or Arkitect Structure Remastered
That includes benches and etc..

Put all dinos in dino depot terminal, they will produce eggs faster and other resources.
Dung Beetles will make Fertilizer and Oil and send to crop Plots
Snails will Produce Cement Paste
Basio will make oil
You can also use the Dino Depot Terminal to transfer between Maps
(Go in its settings and change to terminal)

Use Potions for Raising babies, bypassing mating and changing sex

You can add your Display filters by going into AAT>User Preferences>Automation
Most Common are:
grass.sizescale 0
r.Fog 0
r.VolumetricCloud 0

Build a Nice base
Any structure with less than 20 items have a decay time of 2 days (VIP 4 days)
Bases will have decay time of 8 days (VIP 14 days)
By logging in, you can reset your time for all servers, to check a base type /decaytime
A field will show, showing the area coverage
